original_test_intent: Perform 250 DC reboots while verifying required OS-visible USB topology returns after every boot.

original_procedure_criteria.procedure: Run the source WAT 250-cycle command; title specifies `usbPoll()`.
original_procedure_criteria.criteria: Required USB devices enumerate and platform health remains acceptable.

historical_reviews.v3: IMPROVED REQUIRES PACKAGE / USER CONFIRMATION with physical/sysfs/serial topology, WAT mapping and immutable cycle evidence.

v3_1_conclusion.manual_test_activity: Engineer supplies WAT semantics, DC method and USB matrix; existing WAT may then run the approved campaign.

master_vs_project_parameters.master_default: 250 DC cycles with usbPoll coverage of required OS USB topology.
master_vs_project_parameters.project_inputs: WAT version/mapping, physical hub/port/sysfs and VID:PID/serial matrix, timeouts, power method and failure policy.
master_vs_project_parameters.coverage_difference: Excluded devices, ports or cycles are explicit gaps.

original_method: The exact WAT scenario and usbPoll title are retained without invented token meaning.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use WAT after documented usbPoll mapping and correlate its output with stable controller, physical path and device serial evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: WAT-supported platform and mapped USB topology.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Applicable WAT manual plus platform USB topology documentation.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: Adds topology/serial proof, not a replacement polling script.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Every required USB path and all approved cycles remain in scope.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: Counts cannot distinguish missing, moved or substituted devices.

safety_boundaries: No hidden retry, port substitution or log clearing
expected_evidence: USB errors, BMC/OS logs and final health
no_automatic_retry: No replacement attempt without engineer approval.
review_improvement: KEEP: V3 already prevented adjacent WAT cases from being treated as interchangeable and specified USB-unique identity evidence.
